The '''King's Road''' was a roadway that linked the [[King's Pass]] canyon and [[House Alde (estate)|House Alde]], the estate of the noble [[House Alde]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Both the road and the canyon were named in honor of [[Darrus Alde]], the first [[King/Legends|king]] of Alderaan.
